title: Hybrid Strength 5.0
author: Sima Zarei
desc:
**Hybrid Strength 5.0** is a four-day strength program designed for women who want to build an athletic physique without choosing between lifting and running.

The program prioritizes **glute and hamstring development, back width and thickness, shoulder definition, core and oblique strength, unilateral leg strength, and hip stability**, while managing fatigue so strength training can coexist with regular running.

The four sessions are divided into two upper- and two lower-body days. Each has a specific purpose rather than simply accumulating exercises:

* **Upper A:** Lat width, back development, biceps, and obliques
* **Lower A:** Glute growth and squat strength
* **Upper B:** Back thickness, shoulders, chest, triceps, and anti-rotation core
* **Lower B:** Hamstrings, glutes, unilateral strength, and posterior-chain development

The program combines heavier compound work with moderate- and higher-repetition hypertrophy work. Exercises are ordered so the highest-priority movements receive the most energy and attention.

Progression uses a **double-progression system**: first improve repetitions within the prescribed range while maintaining good technique, then increase resistance. Most working sets are performed with approximately **1–2 reps in reserve**, allowing meaningful training stimulus without requiring constant failure.

Warm-ups and progressive ramp-up sets are incorporated before demanding compound movements, and accessory volume is intentionally controlled to preserve recovery for running.

The goal is not simply to lift more weight or accumulate fatigue. It is to progressively build a **stronger, more muscular, balanced and athletic body that can also run well.**

variations.name: default
days: Upper A - Lat Width + Back + Biceps + Obliques
Upper B - Back Thickness + Shoulders + Chest
Lower B - Hamstrings + Glutes + Posterior Chain
